column1: # Gibson belly points (Hargrave 1986 p. 117) in the drawing's own outline-normalised coordinates: u = distance from the top of the printed belly outline over its height (0 top, 1 bottom), v = (x - centre of the outline on that row) / half the outline's width on that row (-1 viewer's left = bass side, +1 right), outline = largest connected dark component of the 220 dpi page render (threshold 215, closing 5x5), centre and half-width from its left and right extents on the dot's row. thickness_mm as printed.
